text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One holiday, when I headed into town... I 
found an unexpected group in an unexpected 
place.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, that's right! We need to choose 
noodle firmness, broth richness, and 
portion size!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
As for me... for now, I'll go with regular 
for everything! What about you two?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Firm noodles, light broth, and a small 
portion for me. What about you, Saint 
Light-san?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Soft noodles, rich broth, large portion.
choice_data_list: (...Are the three of them close friends?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Each of them had been active in different 
eras. I wondered if their times enrolled 
at the academy even overlapped... As I 
pondered where their connection began—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
—Say. What will you be ordering, my good 
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, delicious. Not overly sweet, just 
the right balance!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Mine is super yummy too~♡ How about yours, 
Saint Light-san—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's already empty?!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Saint Light-san. That 
lightning-fast speed reminds me of your 
legs back during your active racing days.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
My. Have you ever seen my running in 
person?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt. Both in archival footage 
and at the racetrack itself.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list:
When did the three of you get to know each 
other?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
This is probably the first time we've 
properly sat down and talked. Though of 
course, we all knew of each other's 
existence.
choice_data_list:
Ah, so you weren't old friends 
beforehand...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Right. We are gradually becoming friends 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Haiseiko showed us a better path—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Pleased to make your acquaintance, I am 
Speed Symboli. I am truly grateful to you 
for stepping up for the sake of the 
Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
No need for pleasantries. Our objectives 
are one and the same, are they not?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes! For the sake of the beloved and 
precious Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Let's definitely become good friends! 
After all, we're basically members of the 
same unit!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Unit... members...?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Even if our eras differed, as fellow 
racers who ran through it all... I'm sure 
there's so much we can understand about 
each other.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Besides! When our hearts are connected, 
our performance is bound to get so much 
better too!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Rather than just a businesslike trust, I'd 
be so thrilled if we could join hands and 
move forward... just like true friends♪

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Strengthening the coordination between 
the three of us will allow us to unleash 
even greater power. Indeed, a very 
reasonable argument.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That is why we are currently increasing 
the time we spend together to deepen our 
friendship.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The other day, at Haiseiko-kun's request, 
we went to karaoke. We extended our 
session about three times.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Speed Symboli-san, your singing was so 
wonderfully amazing that I was totally 
blown away!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
And before that, we went to an amusement 
center, didn't we? We even went bowling 
and everything♪

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
A place where so many young people gather 
and bustle about in delight... It was 
truly refreshing and enjoyable.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
And on this occasion, having desired this 
thing known as "Hachimi", I have 
accomplished just that.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Next time, I was thinking it 
might be lovely to hang out and chat at a 
family restaurant!
choice_data_list:
It feels kind of... just like students, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It seems we have chosen the most 
effective means to deepen our friendship.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Friends made in one's school days are 
bound by deep ties... It appears this 
approach was not mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so happy to have made friends I 
can have fun with like this even as an 
adult!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! If the timing works out, 
Trainer-san, won't you come join us too?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Thou art also one who shares a 
deep love for the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Let us coordinate together and build a 
finer future... for our beloved children.
